name: manual_4c4373
claim: Discovery endpoints describe model-server endpoints, not peer control-plane or TLS addresses. Treat port 1234 only as the reader default when a discovery snapshot omits port; valid snapshots may specify another port in range. Read the endpoint field meaning and its supplied port before inferring a peer route, certificate identity or reachability result.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit PR 497 review found lesson_a37dc1716537 described port 1234 as an invariant although lan_discovery.py uses it only as the missing-port default and accepts valid supplied ports.
